invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$1980且RSI跌破50，或融资费率Z-score升至100%以上（转为过热），或日线趋势进一步恶化。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $1980 with RSI falling below 50, or funding Z-score rises above 100% (becomes overheated), or daily trend worsens further.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$68000且RSI跌破50，或融资费率转为正且Z-score升至0%以上（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势恶化（如跌破关键支撑）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $68000 with RSI falling below 50, or funding turns positive with Z-score rising above 0% (short pressure eases), or daily trend worsens (e.g., breaks key support).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.088且RSI跌破50，或融资费率转为正且Z-score升至50%以上（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势恶化。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.088 with RSI falling below 50, or funding turns positive with Z-score rising above 50% (short pressure eases), or daily trend worsens.
